title: Vice, Joshua, Angelica, Maris nominated at 42nd Star Awards for Movies
summary: PMPC Star Awards Inc. will honor outstanding films from last year, as well as talented artists and creatives, at the 42nd Star Awards for Movies on October 25 at Winford Resort and Casino Manila.
